predictions.label: TALON projection
predictions.statement: every contract-bearing TALON execution preserves final top-1. Any violation blocks the implementation/cell.

predictions.label: TALM crossings
predictions.statement: TALM usually preserves top-1 in many contexts but permits nonzero intentional crossings; crossings are logged, never repaired.

predictions.label: pillar response
predictions.statement: `talon_mass_right` shows coherent nonzero mechanical response across all three models more often than left/balanced TALON probes; this is not universal utility.

predictions.label: complementarity
predictions.statement: `talm_mass_right_soft` supplies nonredundant response or utility cells beyond fixed `talon_mass_right`.

predictions.label: activity != utility
predictions.statement: utility is not monotone in intervention intensity; some highly active cells are neutral or harmful.

predictions.label: Top-H/TFS nonredundancy
predictions.statement: their masks/fingerprints differ contextually.

predictions.label: C/F/R informativeness
predictions.statement: consensus core, disagreement frontier, and jointly discarded residual differ on at least one registered mechanical/decisional axis.

predictions.label: frontier uncertainty
predictions.statement: frontier mass/instability associates with branch disagreement or route uncertainty and may increase Top-2 value.

predictions.label: BZ/ZX exactness
predictions.statement: partitions are disjoint, conserve mass, and allocate .0025/.05 up to tolerance with fractional boundaries.

predictions.label: portability with heterogeneity
predictions.statement: mechanisms remain numerically stable in all three architectures, while magnitudes and useful jurisdictions remain model-dependent.

predictions.label: no global champion
predictions.statement: fresh data retain local win/tie/loss/baseline-abstention/out-of-support regions; apparent universality triggers audit.

predictions.label: fixed-pillar boundary
predictions.statement: `talon_mass_right` is a strong comparator, but reserve cells exist where baseline or another admitted action is preferable.

predictions.label: complementary RDS
predictions.statement: calibrated abstention-aware RDS exploits some nonredundant cells beyond the fixed pillar; failure is reported, not rescued.

predictions.label: native external duality
predictions.statement: Top-H/TFS may be more useful as delimiters/probes than frequent generators; native status predicts no route frequency.

predictions.label: full vs internal-only RDS
predictions.statement: Top-H/TFS fingerprints/authority improve at least one held-out property: calibration, abstention, support, Top-2 coverage, or false-positive control; unconditional mean is not the target.

predictions.label: model heterogeneity
predictions.statement: action ordering and abstention differ across Qwen/Phi/Gemma; Qwen priors require learned attenuation.

predictions.label: category heterogeneity
predictions.statement: coherent categories have different useful-action/abstention profiles; category summaries beat pooled ranking descriptively.

predictions.label: long-context novelty
predictions.statement: long heterodox prompts expose response, repetition, termination, coherence, or safety phenomena absent from 944-token microcartography.

predictions.label: conditional QAS fidelity
predictions.statement: high for some action-context pairs, not universal; deployment requires a fidelity gate.

predictions.label: QAS efficiency
predictions.statement: fidelity-admitted cells reduce support size, memory, latency, or compute proxy without breaching tolerance.

predictions.label: Z_post limits
predictions.statement: Z_post predicts response/support better than semantic utility unless combined with independent semantic evidence.

predictions.label: Z_post transfer
predictions.statement: some development jurisdictions transfer to fresh prompts better than unconditioned global rankings; otherwise remain retrospective.

predictions.label: delayed learning
predictions.statement: OBL changes later route probabilities/lifecycle while base weights and revision hashes remain fixed.

predictions.label: no leakage
predictions.statement: current outputs/Z_post never influence their already frozen route.

predictions.label: hierarchical transfer
predictions.statement: partial pooling with learned attenuation improves at least one held-out calibration criterion over branch-independent or unchanged-Qwen transfer.

predictions.label: typed evidence
predictions.statement: six-axis modelling improves calibration or error localization over scalar success updates.

predictions.label: dynamic controller
predictions.statement: full dynamic hierarchy improves at least one held-out decision/calibration criterion over static priors without exceeding harm tolerance.

predictions.label: abstention
predictions.statement: uncertainty/harm gates yield nonzero abstention and reduce unsupported interventions versus forced selection.

predictions.label: hysteresis
predictions.statement: reduces lifecycle thrashing versus matched single-threshold logic.

predictions.label: bench reentry
predictions.statement: at least one branch may recover after material context shift; inability to reevaluate makes bench archival.

predictions.label: NF4 boundary
predictions.statement: exact invariants and qualitative signatures survive NF4; utility magnitudes and routes may differ from BF16.

predictions.label: reproducibility
predictions.statement: identical frozen inputs reproduce deterministic contracts, static hashes, row keys, and completeness counts; stochastic text identity is required only where the runtime guarantees it.

predictions.label: BZ rare-yield structure
predictions.statement: BZ has low win frequency, high variance, high leverage conditional on a win, and heavier-tailed local utility than ZX or ordinary truncators.

predictions.label: ZX coverage
predictions.statement: ZX increases residual-shell coverage and reduces repeated visitation of identical residual bands relative to matched ordinary sampling.

predictions.label: BZ/ZX contrast
predictions.statement: BZ produces fewer useful events, more extreme rank movement, larger conditional trajectory change, and greater failure risk than broader ZX exploration.

predictions.label: structured-Z controls
predictions.statement: active BZ must outperform equal-mass random reallocation on its registered rare-yield target, and ZX must outperform shuffled residual reallocation on coverage; otherwise the corresponding mechanism is falsified.

predictions.label: structural scale covariance
predictions.statement: the macro-to-micro role map is supported only if branch autonomy, heteropolarity, higher-order authority, abstention, generation/arbitration separation, and delayed post-hoc learning are operationally measurable invariants; failure to operationalize them falsifies this claim.
